releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.6.0 (Strict <=50KB Solver, Word OCR Inpainting & Studio Passport)
changelog:
🚀 Major Pro Release v10.6.0:
• Strict <=50KB File Size Solver: Guaranteed file size <= targetBytes (e.g. strict <=50 KB for UPSC/SSC portals) with raw MediaStore gallery stream (no re-compression bloat) and Exact/Decrease modes.
• Word-Level OCR & In-Place Baseline Editing: Tapping a word selects only that word instead of the whole line. Replaced text stays on the exact same baseline with horizontal condensing (no multi-line wrap or ghost letter outlines).
• Dedicated Home Action Shortcuts: 'Edit Photo/PDF Text', 'Whiteout & Eraser', 'DocuEdit Magic Color', 'Extract Text (OCR)', and 'Restore Photo' now open directly into their specialized active tool modes.
• Pro Studio Passport Photo Maker: Full-resolution raw size neural mask with smooth Hermite S-curve edge feathering and realistic radial key lighting.
• Studio Facial Sharpening & Lighting: LAB CLAHE lighting balance, bilateral skin smoothing, and unsharp mask for crystal-clear eyes, hair, and facial clarity.
• Formal Attire & Suit Replacement: 1-click formal suits, blazers, and white collared shirts with collar height and shoulder width adjustment.
• Custom Photo Borders & Cutting Guides: 0px, 1px, 2px, 4px border styles with Slate Gray, Black, and White color options.
